description: We are a creative and passionate team interested in space exploration, science, technology, and coding. Our project, Junior Astronaut Mission Trainer, aims to create an interactive experience where users can complete space missions, learn about astronauts, and explore the universe. We welcome teammates who are passionate about programming, game design, science, UI/UX design, and creative problem-solving. Let's build something amazing together!
summary:
"LM-7 AQUARIUS SHELTER" is our response to NASA’s Junior Astronaut Mission Trainer challenge: a 3D lunar outpost simulator that puts players in the role of managing a future Moon base.

Players experience the challenges of operating an outpost in an environment where resources, safety, and infrastructure are limited. By exploring and interacting with the shelter, they can understand how different systems work together and how decisions made in one part of the mission can affect the entire outpost.

Our project transforms complex concepts involved in lunar habitation into an interactive and accessible experience. Rather than simply learning about the challenges astronauts may face, players can experience them through simulation and decision-making. We hope LM-7 AQUARIUS SHELTER encourages students to think like astronauts, engineers, and mission planners while developing a deeper interest in STEM and future lunar exploration.
details:
LM-7 AQUARIUS SHELTER is a 3D lunar outpost simulator developed in response to NASA's Junior Astronaut Mission Trainer challenge. Our project aims to recreate the experience of exploring and understanding a human habitat on the Moon through an immersive digital environment.

The project focuses on the challenges of establishing a sustainable human presence beyond Earth. By presenting a lunar shelter in a three-dimensional environment, users can explore the concept of lunar habitation and better understand the infrastructure required to support astronauts in an extreme environment.

What makes our project creative is its use of 3D visualization to transform an otherwise complex aerospace topic into an accessible and engaging experience. Rather than relying entirely on traditional educational materials, we use an interactive simulation to bring the concept of a lunar outpost closer to students.

Our intended impact is to encourage curiosity about space exploration, introduce students to the engineering challenges of living on the Moon, and inspire interest in STEM fields and future space missions.
